name: 数据库管理与安全
description: 备份恢复、授权、审计、加密、监控与数据库运维；安全理论见安全领域。

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 Documentation, Part III. Server Administration (official)
sources.covers: Ch18 Server Setup (18.8 Encryption Options, 18.9 SSL, 18.10 GSSAPI, 18.11 SSH tunnels), Ch19 Server Configuration (19.3 Connections and Authentication, 19.8 Error Reporting and Logging, 19.9 Run-time Statistics, 19.10 Vacuuming), Ch20 Client Authentication, Ch21 Database Roles (attributes, membership, predefined roles, function security), Ch24 Routine Maintenance (vacuum, reindex, log-file maintenance), Ch25 Backup and Restore (SQL dump, file-system backup, continuous archiving/PITR), Ch26 HA/Replication, Ch27 Monitoring (cumulative statistics, locks, progress reporting, disk usage), Ch28 WAL/Reliability, Ch29 Logical Replication.
sources.access: Free official HTML documentation, no registration. It is a product manual: audit is only covered as logging/statistics, there is no dedicated audit chapter (pgAudit is an extension, see en2).

evidence.location: Part III table of contents, Ch18–Ch29
evidence.finding: Page title is 'Documentation: 18: Part III. Server Administration'; TOC lists server setup with encryption/SSL, client authentication, roles, routine maintenance, backup and restore, HA/replication, monitoring, WAL and logical replication.

sources.title: pgAudit — Open Source PostgreSQL Audit Logging (official extension README)
sources.covers: Explains why plain log_statement is not an audit trail, then documents session and object audit logging, audit roles/privileges and configuration. Supplies the dedicated 审计 topic that en1 lacks.
sources.access: Free open-source documentation on GitHub; installing the extension requires a PostgreSQL server build with pgAudit.
sources.publisher: pgAudit project (PostgreSQL Global Development Group-affiliated extension)

evidence.location: Introduction, Why pgAudit?, audit logging sections
evidence.finding: README states pgAudit 'provides detailed session and/or object audit logging via the standard PostgreSQL logging facility' and contrasts it with log_statement = all; the rest of the file documents settings and audit roles.

topics.note: 两套 PostgreSQL 手册都只有日志，没有审计专章；中文审计由 openGauss 审计章补齐，英文由 pgAudit 文档补齐。；原zh1仅日志层为partial，原zh2概述路径本轮不可读；现用官方审计实例补上事件选择、身份及操作追踪和记录维护。与原zh1日志基础合起来完成数据库审计实践，不把普通日志等同审计。；原en1仅日志层为partial；原en2的实际示例已重新核实，按配置→SQL→预期日志→字段解读完成审计教学，与原PostgreSQL日志管理组合覆盖此项。保留原已覆盖其他主题。

steps.read: 读第18.8–18.11 配置加密与 SSL/SSH 隧道，第20–21 章建角色、配 pg_hba.conf 与最小权限；在一台本地实例上实际创建角色并限制库/表权限。
读第24 章做 vacuum/reindex/日志轮转，第25 章分别做一次 SQL dump、文件系统备份与 PITR 恢复演练，第27 章用累计统计、锁视图和进度视图观察一次慢查询。
读 openGauss 审计概述并对照自己的实例列出应开启的审计项；若只用 PostgreSQL，可把审计项映射到 log_statement/pgAudit 配置。
读原PostgreSQL中文手册日志基础后，以oGRAC独立案例学习审计类型、记录字段和维护策略；这些命令不直接用于PostgreSQL。
Work through Ch18.8–18.11, Ch20–21 for encryption/auth/roles, then Ch24–25 for maintenance and backup/PITR; do each operation on a local cluster.
Read Ch27 and 19.9, then use pg_stat_* and lock/progress views to diagnose one slow query and one bloat case.
Install pgAudit and configure session/object audit logging; read the README's audit-role and settings sections to see what plain log_statement misses.
原服务器管理路线后读Why pgAudit及两套Example；在匹配扩展版本的练习实例重现SQL与日志差异，识别哪些事件没有被记录。

findings: 原英文资源 PostgreSQL 18 Part III 已核对目录，备份恢复、授权、加密、监控与日常维护都有章；但「审计」只有日志与统计，没有审计专章，英文需补 pgAudit 文档才算覆盖。
原中文条目 openGauss 文档首页只有产品入口，无法定位到具体章节；本次改用同构的 PostgreSQL 18.3 中文手册（完整正文、可逐章核对），并用 openGauss 审计章补中文审计，中文路线才覆盖六项。
「安全理论见安全领域」是原简介写明的树外边界，两语言都不在本节点教，标 extension 并注明依据。
